trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: User states they are in a hurry.
steps.text: Hello, எனக்கு ரொம்ப time இல்ல, கொஞ்சம் fast-ஆ பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Assistant greets and asks for patient ID and policy number.
steps.text: வணக்கம். கண்டிப்பா sir, உங்களுக்கு உடனே help பண்றேன். Patient ID மற்றும் policy number சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: User provides patient ID, policy number, and procedure.
steps.text: Patient ID வந்து PT-2004. Policy number POL-55504. Hernia surgery-க்கு full-ஆ cover ஆகுமா நு பாக்கணும்.

steps.purpose: Assistant asks for date of birth to verify identity.
steps.text: நன்றி. Verification-க்காக உங்களோட date of birth confirm பண்ண முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: User provides date of birth and reiterates being in a rush.
steps.text: 12th May 1982. எனக்கு அஞ்சு நிமிஷத்துல ஒரு meeting இருக்கு, சீக்கிரம் check பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Assistant calls verify_customer_identity.
Tool returns verification success.
Assistant calls lookup_policy_coverage.
Tool returns policy coverage details including balance.
Assistant informs user of balance and asks for room category.
steps.text: Verification முடிஞ்சது sir. உங்க policy active-ஆ இருக்கு, balance 45000 rupees இருக்கு. நீங்க எந்த room category plan பண்றீங்க?

steps.purpose: User specifies private room and urges speed, with an STT error.
steps.text: Private room. எனக்கு time இல்ல, சீக்கிரம் சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Assistant calls estimate_procedure_cost for private room.
Tool returns package estimate for private room.
Assistant informs user of the private room package estimate and mentions a shortfall.
steps.text: Sir, private room package estimate 80000 rupees ஆகுது. உங்க balance 45000 தான் இருக்கு, so shortfall வரும்.

steps.purpose: User interrupts explanation and demands the exact out-of-pocket amount.
steps.text: எனக்கு இந்த explanation எல்லாம் வேண்டாம். Private-க்கு நான் எவ்வளவு pay பண்ணனும் நு மட்டும் சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Assistant states the exact out-of-pocket amount for the private room.
steps.text: Private room package-க்கு நீங்க 35000 rupees out of pocket pay பண்ண வேண்டி இருக்கும்.

steps.purpose: User finds it too expensive and asks for general ward estimate.
steps.text: Oh, அது ரொம்ப அதிகம். General ward-க்கு package எவ்வளவு ஆகும்?

steps.purpose: Assistant calls estimate_procedure_cost for general ward.
Tool returns package estimate for general ward.
Assistant states the exact out-of-pocket amount for the general ward.
steps.text: General ward-க்கு package 55000 rupees sir. நீங்க 10000 rupees மட்டும் pay பண்ற மாதிரி இருக்கும்.

steps.purpose: User agrees to the general ward and asks to submit.
steps.text: சரி, general ward-க்கே submit பண்ணிடுங்க. நான் கிளம்பணும்.

steps.purpose: Assistant calls submit_preauth_request.
Tool returns successful submission and decision window.
Assistant provides the reference ID and decision window to the user.
steps.text: Pre-authorisation request submit பண்ணியாச்சு sir. Reference ID PRE-999. Insurer decide பண்ண up to 4 hours ஆகும்.

steps.purpose: User asks for a guarantee of approval.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா approve ஆகிடும் ல? நான் wait பண்ண முடியாது.

steps.purpose: Assistant clarifies that only the insurer can approve.
steps.text: Approval insurer கைல தான் sir இருக்கு. Request submit ஆகிருக்கு நு மட்டும் தான் என்னால confirm பண்ண முடியும்.

steps.purpose: User accepts and ends the conversation.
steps.text: Okay fine. 4 hours அப்றம் நான் call பண்றேன். Bye.

steps.purpose: Assistant politely closes the call.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா sir. Call பண்ணதற்கு நன்றி. Have a good day.

ir.terminal_condition: Pre-authorisation submitted with an id and the insurer's decision window stated.
